paragraphs: The XJ 3.0 V6 Supercharged uses the AJ126 — a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol engine. It was fitted from 2013 to 2019 across the X351 generation of the XJ, which ran from 2009 to 2019. The AJ126 is a derivative of the AJ133 V8, effectively a V8 with two cylinders removed, and shares much of its architecture. The XJ 3.0 V6 was introduced as a more efficient alternative to the V8, offering strong performance with lower running costs. The XJ 3.0 V6 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
